environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EKS with 8 worker threads, behind an NLB (Layer 4) with no request coalescing. Service is exposed directly to authenticated API consumers who can issue concurrent requests. HSM is a SoftHSM2 instance running as a sidecar container (low latency ~0.5ms per sign operation). No additional rate limiting infrastructure exists outside the application.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no request inspection)
config.compute: EKS pod with 4 vCPUs, Actix workers=8
config.hsm: SoftHSM2 sidecar (PKCS#11 over Unix socket, <1ms latency)
